verdict.rationale: mParticle documents real management APIs (Platform Audiences API, Warehouse Sync API, HTTP events API) and an Integrations directory, so an agent could plausibly automate parts of the pipeline, but the docs explicitly describe connecting an audience to an output as a manual UI action ('Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory, and click the card for your audience partner') rather than an API call, and there is no mention of an MCP server or agent-oriented control plane. Missing for 10: an MCP server, documented API endpoints for creating/wiring destinations and inspecting delivery status, and any hands-on evidence of agent-driven pipeline configuration.
